headlines.title: Is T-Mobile US (TMUS) Trading At A Discount To Its Earnings?
headlines.summary: T-Mobile US has climbed over the years into one of the largest U.S. wireless players, yet its recent share price swings leave a clear question for you as an investor: Is the current valuation of T-Mobile US, at around US$171 per share, adequately grounded in the earnings the business is generating today? Over the past 5 years, T-Mobile US has delivered a share price gain of 53.

headlines.title: T-Mobile Powers New Ways to Experience the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX On and Off the Track
headlines.summary: BELLEVUE, Wash., November 12, 2026--T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) is bringing its Formula 1 regional partnership to life at the intersection of performance and culture. At one of the world’s most exciting and demanding live events, the network helps the race run smarter and gives fans and members more ways to experience it.

headlines.title: From Tornado Devastation to a $1 Million Victory: Wisconsin’s Menasha High School Wins T-Mobile's Friday Night 5G Lights
headlines.summary: BELLEVUE, Wash., November 12, 2026--From over 2,400 applications to 40 Division Finalists to four Division Champions, and more than 3.2 million votes cast, the competition has come down to one school. Today, T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) officially crowns Menasha High School in Menasha, Wis., this year’s Friday Night 5G Lights $1 million grand prize champion.

headlines.title: Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile shut out Elon Musk’s phone service. Now the FCC is reviewing SpaceX’s plan to build its own
headlines.summary: SpaceX could spend billions to take on Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile, as Elon Musk’s push into wireless aims to reshape America’s mobile market.

headlines.title: T-Mobile Settles Charges It Violated NY Broadband Law
headlines.summary: T-Mobile allegedly throttled Affordable Broadband Act plan subscribers to speeds of just 600 Kbps after they hit a monthly data cap of 50 Gigabytes.

description: T-Mobile US, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides wireless communications services in the United States, Puerto Rico, and the United States Virgin Islands. The company offers voice, messaging, and data services to postpaid, prepaid, and wholesale and other services customers. It also provides wireless devices, including smartphones, wearables, tablets, home broadband gateways, headsets, and other mobile communication devices, as well as accessories; financing through equipment installment plans; reinsurance for device insurance policies and extended warranty contracts. The company offers services under the T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile brands through its owned and operated retail stores, customer care channels, national retailers, and its websites, as well as through T-Mobile, Metro by T-Mobile, and Mint Mobile apps. It also sells devices to dealers and other third-party distributors for resale through independent third-party retail outlets and various third-party websites. It has 700 MHz wireless spectrum licenses. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. T-Mobile US, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Deutsche Telekom AG.
